description:
Purchases one configured offer with atomic costs and value/item rewards, retaining only a minimal public duplicate guard.
Use when: a player confirms an offer returned by horizon_get_player_value_offers.
Not for: choosing arbitrary costs or rewards; only the server's configured offer is accepted.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken. Persist operationId before the first request.
Side effects: Debits and credits together once. Same ID and body replay without another debit; no automatic retries or new IDs.
Returns: Current state with operation:{operationId,replayed,alreadyApplied,applied,items}. Fresh success contains committed deltas and new item references; replay has empty applied/items. Never add an old reward delta locally.
Errors: 409 STATE_CONFLICT: refresh state and retry the SAME operation ID and payload. OPERATION_CONFLICT: do not reuse an ID for a different action. OPERATION_EXPIRED: reconcile state/history; never silently generate another ID. INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, MAX_BALANCE_REACHED or DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED leaves the whole operation unapplied. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

offerKey.description: Configured value or offer key, 1 to 24 lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'

operationId.description: Stable operation ID: server-aligned Unix milliseconds + ':' + UUID. Persist before sending; reuse unchanged on timeout or retry

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken from sign-in, sent only in the Authorization Bearer header

userId.description: Player UUID belonging to the selected project and player session

name: horizon_purchase_player_value_offer
title: Purchase Player Value Offer
